correctness.rationale: The even-signed group has 1920 elements, interval 182 elements with rank counts (1,20,70,70,20,1), proper-part chains (180,1536,3328,2048), and 3-dimensional cyclic orbit-cell counts (32,228,448,256). Conjugation is rank-preserving without inversions; boundaries are alternating deleted-face orbit sums and source checker constructs complete integer matrices and Smith factors ∂1:1^31, ∂2:1^196,2, ∂3:1^250,2. From exact complex ranks and torsion, H1 and H2 each have one order-two factor and H3 has rank five. Independently rebuilt all 1920 signed group elements, proper NC order, chain orbits and exact zero boundary compositions; modular ranks are (31,196,250) in characteristic two and (31,197,251) modulo 3,5,7,101, supporting the source exact SNF. EL-shellability makes the original three-dimensional X simply connected; Armstrong isotropy quotient C8/C4=C2 as vertex orbit sizes >=2 with size-two orbits. No claim beyond D5.
